query: SELECT pc.id, pc.parentProductId, pc.childProductId, pc.quantity, p1.name as parent_name, p2.name as child_name FROM productCompositions pc JOIN products p1 ON pc.parentProductId = p1.id JOIN products p2 ON pc.childProductId = p2.id WHERE p1.name = 'Dose Gin Dober'
